name.description:
Name for vertex that is locally unique to the graph. Used for visualization, as well as user access. This should
NOT be a UUID.

inTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

outTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

x.description: Names of ports corresponding to x input.

y.description: Names of ports corresponding to y input.

context.description: Names of ports corresponding to context input.

convertSpec.description: {@link MlConvertSpec} used by callable interface of {@link #interpreter}

isXNestedInput.description: Whether the vertex has nested-input ports for x.

title: A specialized {@link FlowGraph.Vertex} that represents an interpreter vertex in an {@link MlPipeline}
name: MlPipeline.InterpretVertex
